**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 (¶¶ p0068–p0069) already delivers our preferred insurance position in full:

| Preferred requirement | Section 18.1–18.2 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occ, 2M aggregate | ✔ exact match |
| Professional / E&O USD 2M | ✔ exact match |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (processes Customer Data) | ✔ exact match — and Vendor does process Customer Data per §§ 15, 17 |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✔ plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra cover) |
| Certificates on request | ✔ § 18.2, with evidence of coverage |

Additional favorable terms: coverage runs throughout the term **and one year afterward** (matching our model language), policies from reputable insurers and primary to our insurance where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — so it does not erode the Section 21 liability regime or the Excluded Claims carve-outs for data, security, and confidentiality breaches.

The clause binds the counterparty and runs in our favor, so no edit is warranted.
